versions.changelog:
- Initial release of browser-fingerprint-audit skill.
- Audits browser fingerprints for internal inconsistencies using the liarjs CLI.
- Supports checks including canvas, WebGL, WebGL2, WebGPU, audio, 220 fonts, WebRTC, and timezone, scored against network-side (TLS/HTTP/ASN) fingerprint.
- Provides trustworthiness score and reports failed checks with explanations.
- Works with locally launched or already running browsers via Chrome DevTools Protocol.
- Requires no installation beyond Node 22+ and a local Chrome/Chromium/Edge instance.
